title: Sales Account Executive - Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

About the Role

We are looking for an Account Executive to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. This is a remote based in the major or mid-sized US market, reporting to the Regional Director. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers
  • Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals
  • Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to comprehensive account planning
  • Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning technical solutions with their strategic goals

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • 5+ years of full-cycle sales experience within the software or security industry
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Progressive selling experience engaging with enterprise accounts and selling at the C-Level
  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Established relationships with current and prospective customers and a deep understanding of how technology facilitates high-level business goals
  • Proficiency in strategic sales planning with a proven track record of closing net new logos
  • Experience meeting or exceeding sales targets while leveraging channel partnerships
  • Effectively leverage LLMs and Generative AI tools to boost productivity and sales effectiveness across research, prospecting, customer prep, and opportunity management

Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits.

title: Senior Director, Investor Relations & Strategic Finance
descriptionHtml:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role 

We are looking for a Senior Director, Investor Relations & Strategic Finance to join our team. This is a Hybrid role reporting to the SVP of Investor Relations & Strategic Finance in the Finance department. This is an opportunity for a high-conviction finance leader who wants true ownership to translate our category-defining "Zero Trust" platform vision into a powerful investment thesis, build strong technical and financial credibility with the investment community, and systematically expand our network of institutional investors globally. You will be a key thought partner with the SVP and work in close partnership with the broader team.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Architect the Financial Narrative: Partner directly with the SVP and cross-functional team to author and continuously refine a compelling, forward-looking narrative that highlights our company strategy, platform value, and operational growth levers to ensure a fair market valuation. This includes drafting quarterly earnings scripts, Q&A, and other investor-facing materials. You will steer the market’s focus toward our long-term "Platform" value proposition and the drivers powering our growth.
  • Drive Outbound IR: Proactively manage and cultivate high-trust relationships with sell-side analysts and institutional investors. Tell the Zscaler story to existing and prospective investors in a compelling, yet credible fashion to demystify complex technical structures and share our long-term vision, in order to attract new and retain existing long-term investors. 
  • Drive Global Investor Targeting: Prioritize proactive investor targeting to identify and build relationships with prospective institutional shareholders who do not yet own company stock, while effectively utilizing management’s time to focus on the highest priorities. 
  • Deliver High-Impact Investor-Facing Events: Collaborate on design and execution of our annual Investor Day, investor sessions at customer conferences, marketing roadshows, and conference schedules
  • Develop a Strong Feedback Loop: Deliver real-time investor sentiment and feedback to executives in partnership with the team, from investor conversations and market developments. 
  • Cross-Functional Strategic Finance: Support high-impact corporate development and strategic finance initiatives including M&A due diligence and long-range planning.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You adapt to ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it and see ambiguity as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for internal and external customers, anchoring your decisions in solving their real-world problems.
  • You operate with urgency. You understand that speed and quality are not mutually exclusive, delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, embracing a challenge culture with clear, respectful ongoing feedback.
  • You are data-driven. You use data and analytics to find the truth, measure what matters, and guide informed decisions.
  • You are driven by innovation. You have a deep curiosity for how things work and are energized by solving complex technical challenges. You believe in the power of technology to accelerate transformation and are always looking for a better, more secure, and scalable way.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience positioning AI-driven product pipelines, as well as utilizing modern analytics tools to optimize IR workflows

descriptionHtml:

We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role 

We are looking for a Principal Engineer, Vulnerability & Exposure Management to join our team. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Information Security Engineering in the Product Security department. 

This critical role helps modernize how exposure is discovered, prioritized, and reduced across our cloud, infrastructure, applications, APIs, endpoints, containers, and internet-facing assets. As an individual contributor, you will own our external attack surface management (EASM) technology, set the technical direction for the team, and engineer resilient systems that automate exposure identification, routing, and verified remediation.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Own EASM end to end: discovering internet-facing assets, mapping each to its owner, confirming what is exploitable, routing findings to owners and the SOC, and verifying closure with evidence
  • Design and build the system behind the program: ingestion, enrichment, storage, ticketing and reconciliation, running daily and alerting when something fails
  • Build risk-based prioritization that goes beyond standard CVSS, using exploitability, threat intelligence, runtime exposure and business context
  • Set the technical direction for the team: what to build or fix next across scanning, exposure and automation, why, and the plan to get there, while mentoring engineers and raising the team's technical bar
  • Drive remediation across engineering, IT, cloud security and the SOC, turn gaps that nobody owns into a named route, and report exposure trends to leadership

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 12+ years of experience in software or security engineering, including at least 8 years in security
  • You have designed and built a security platform or system end to end and driven its adoption across teams to measurable results. You write and debug code yourself (Python, APIs, data pipelines). AI-assisted coding is welcome, as long as you can explain and debug what you ship
  • Deep understanding of how attacks and discovery work. You can explain how a vulnerability is exploited from input to impact, and how authenticated and unauthenticated scanning, coverage gaps and asset correlation work
  • You have set technical direction for a team, grown engineers, and explained exposure risk and trade-offs to senior leadership

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leveraging AI/ML technologies and advanced orchestration platforms to design intelligent, self-service triage, automated remediation routing, and predictive exposure analysis workflows
  • Hands-on experience with EASM, CTEM or attack-path analysis, and with tools such as Tenable, Qualys, Wiz, CrowdStrike or Burp Suite
  • Cloud network exposure across AWS, Azure and GCP, Kubernetes and container security, and experience at large scale (millions of assets, short-lived cloud resources)

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer (Service Platform & Orchestration) to join our team. This is a Hybrid (3 days in office) role, reporting to the VP, Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department. In this high-ownership position, you will engineer the management plane and reliability systems that govern ZIA’s fleet lifecycle at massive scale. 

This is a hands-on building role where you will lead the transformation of our infrastructure from legacy automation into a stateful, durable management plane (built on Temporal) to achieve deterministic "one-touch" provisioning and lifecycle operations. You will treat "infrastructure as a distributed system," developing self-healing capabilities and AI-driven SRE practices for a global fleet of 100k+ instances.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead the hands-on development and migration to a workflow-as-code platform (Temporal), building replay-safe, idempotent workflows that ensure deterministic operations across a global scale
  • Move the organization beyond "scripted automation" toward a robust management plane that treats the entire global fleet as a single, eventually-consistent distributed system
  • Design and implement services that leverage LLMs and ML for intelligent signal correlation, automated triage, and "self-correcting" fleet operations
  • Develop framework-level services and internal APIs that ensure all new products are delivered "orchestration-ready" with reliability hooks built directly into the code
  • Build deep telemetry (metrics, traces, and events) into the management plane so that every fleet-wide action is fully explainable, auditable, and replayable

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.
  • You think at scale. You connect your day-to-day work to the larger company mission and think globally. You build solutions, processes, and teams that are not just effective today but are built to last and support a high-growth, global organization.
  • You are resilient and adaptable. You view change as an opportunity and setbacks as temporary. You maintain composure and focus in high-pressure situations, guiding yourself and your team through complexity with a steady, positive hand.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related technical field with 5+ years of experience in hyperscale systems, with a deep understanding of the unique failure modes and technical hurdles that only emerge at massive scale
  • Mastery of backend systems languages with a strong preference for Go (or deep expertise in Java, C++, or Python with a demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt Go), along with a proven track record of setting the bar for code quality and distributed system correctness.
  • Strong experience designing and operating complex distributed systems, with a focus on solving systemic challenges in concurrency, failure handling, and performance optimization
  • Proven track record of developing Platform APIs (REST/gRPC) with strong guarantees for idempotency, verification, and safe rollout patterns
  • U.S. citizenship due to the nature of the customers assigned to this role

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proficiency with AI code-assistance tools (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf) to accelerate legacy refactoring and system development
  • Proficiency in PostgreSQL, or other relational stores used for high-scale, stateful management-plane services
  • Direct experience building or operating systems with Temporal.io, Cadence, or similar workflow engines

descriptionHtml:

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、製造業等を担当するMajorチーム（従業員40000名以上のお客様担当）のリージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはSaaS業界における10年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI/ML技術に関する基礎知識、および担当する業務領域において成果を最適化するために、AI主導型ソリューションを活用・保護・展開した経験

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

This is an implementation-focused role for someone who can ship production-grade security controls, develop secure reference architectures, and drive response and remediation for security issues across AI systems and cloud-native environments.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Build secure agent runtimes, reusable libraries, reference implementations, and validation pipelines for agentic AI applications and workflows
  • Implement secure agent patterns including planner/executor flows, tool routing, structured outputs, memory/state controls, and RAG trust boundaries
  • Design and implement security controls for cloud-native environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including IAM, workload protection, and logging
  • Partner with platform and engineering teams to embed secure-by-default cloud controls into shared services and developer workflows
  • Lead incident response, triage, and remediation workflows for cloud platforms and AI systems in partnership with SOC and engineering teams

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You are a pragmatic builder who is obsessed with creating, iterating, and shipping secure reference architectures, balancing technical excellence with rapid, hands-on value delivery.
  • You thrive in ambiguity and feel comfortable designing secure paths for cutting-edge technologies like Agentic AI where standards are still evolving.
  • You are driven by innovation, bringing deep curiosity and technical engineering fundamentals to solve complex, novel security challenges in cloud and AI environments.
  • You act like an owner with a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level cloud security strategy and deep, hands-on control implementation.
  • You are resilient and adaptable, maintaining composure and focus during critical incident response activities to guide cross-functional teams toward swift remediation.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 7+ years of experience in security engineering, cloud security, application security, or platform security with direct implementation ownership
  • Strong coding skills with experience delivering production systems, with Python, TypeScript, or Node preferred
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, including tool/function calling, multi-step planning, RAG, memory/state management, and orchestration
  • Strong cloud security experience in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including IAM, logging/monitoring, workload protection, Kubernetes, and IaC security
  • Practical experience in incident response, including investigation, coordination, and remediation utilizing SIEM, SOAR, EDR, CSPM, or CNAPP tools

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Familiarity with OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, and modern cloud security frameworks
  • Experience building red-team style testing or evaluation harnesses for LLM applications and agentic systems
  • 10+ years of experience in security engineering, cloud security, application security, or platform security with direct implementation ownership

また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはSaaS業界における最低5年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI/ML技術に関する基礎知識、および担当する業務領域において成果を最適化するために、AI主導型ソリューションを活用・保護・展開した経験

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

Role

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Take total ownership of the technical sale and associated processes

  • Independently deliver high-impact sales pitches, technical demonstrations, and whiteboard presentations

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

  • High fluency in written and spoken Japanese

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience working with routing and switching products, including complex troubleshooting

  • Solid understanding of SaaS-based technologies and network security frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with systems installation, configuration, and administration of macOS, UNIX/Linux, and Windows-based systems

  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs.

title: Transformation Architect - Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We’re looking for a Transformation Architect - Enterprise who brings technical depth, business acumen, and a relentless curiosity about how our enterprise customers operate. This is a role for someone who takes pride in exceptional work, earns trust quickly, and helps customers turn complex challenges into clear digital transformation strategies. 

In this role, you will lead customer engagements that uncover business challenges, assess current-state architecture, and guide our critical healthcare customers toward a differentiated future-state design built on Zscaler’s Zero Trust Exchange to help them securely modernize and achieve their digital transformation goals.

You’ll facilitate interactive whiteboard sessions and strategic workshops, combining deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help our customers plan and accelerate their Zero Trust transformation. Your work will shape high-level architectures, transformation roadmaps, and design strategies that are critical to supporting both the success of our customers and our West Healthcare Sales Team.

What You’ll do:

  • Lead cross-functional workshops to uncover business priorities, technical challenges, and current-state architecture
  • Guide customers through Zero Trust digital transformation aligned to business goals
  • Identify pain points, drivers for change, and decision criteria
  • Translate customer requirements into architectures, use cases, and solution designs
  • Lead clearly articulated strategic architecture discussions with both executive and technical stakeholders
  • Differentiate Zscaler through technical vision and architecture leadership
  • Create high-level Zero Trust architectures and transformation roadmaps
  • Assess existing environments and deliver actionable future-state recommendations, including High-Level Design documentation
  • Influence and mentor teammates across the organization

Who You Are:

  • Curious and Customer-Obsessed: You have a relentless curiosity in understanding how our customers operate, the challenges they face, and the barriers to success.
  • Proud of your work: Drive high-quality execution with a strong standard for clarity, rigor, and meaningful business results. You move with urgency and focus on results that matter 
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: Create structure from ambiguity and confidently lead complex initiatives from concept to action.
  • Collaborative and high-trust: Build trusted cross-functional partnerships through candid communication, strong collaboration, and a focus on the best outcome.
  • Focused Communicator: Communicate complex ideas simply to any audience and act with urgency to turn business and technical challenges into clear, practical results.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Native level Japanese language ability
  • 10+ years of experience in networking and cybersecurity
  • Advanced degree or equivalent technical experience, supported by relevant industry certifications
  • Deep knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture and related laws, regulations, and best practices
  • Strong understanding of networking and security environments
  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated technical depth and credibility through advanced industry certifications in networking, cybersecurity, or network architecture (e.g., CCIE, JNCIE, CISSP, or equivalent).
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical leadership or evangelist role
  • Cloud expertise or experience in adjacent technical domains
  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate AI-generated recommendations and outputs
  • Experience positioning AI-driven threat intelligence, automated policy enforcement, or AI security frameworks to enterprise clients

Role 

We are looking for a Production Engineer to join our team. This role is available as a hybrid opportunity 3 days a week in San Jose, CA or Bellevue, WA reporting to Production Engineering in the Cloud Infrastructure & Operations department. Join Zscaler to be a force multiplier for the reliability of a global platform processing 200+ billion transactions daily across tens of millions of enterprise users.  

In this role, you will provide the technical vision and hands-on execution to drive an "automation-first" culture across the company. By maturing our observability and architectural standards, you will directly reduce our Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM) and shape the scalability of our globally distributed, multi-cloud infrastructure.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Implement highly available, scalable infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and bare-metal environments
  • Drive an "automation-first" culture by writing code (Python/Go) to eliminate manual toil and build self-healing systems
  • Implement and maintain sophisticated observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), define SLIs/SLOs, and establish error budgets
  • Act as a lead Incident Commander (TDO on-call), develop response playbooks, and conduct deep-dive post-incident analyses

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

As the Sr Manager, GTM Communications, you will serve as the strategic voice of our Global Sales organization. In this high-visibility role, you will manage the end-to-end communication lifecycle for the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) and GTM leaders, translating complex cybersecurity and go-to-market strategies into clear, actionable, and inspiring narratives for our global sales force and external stakeholders.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Act as the primary communications partner for the CRO and GTM leadership, managing internal and external platforms including board-level presentations, state of the union updates, and industry keynotes
  • Drive the editorial and creative direction for the mainstage experience at annual Sales Kick-Off (SKO) events, including theme development, keynote scripting, and visual storytelling
  • Design and orchestrate a holistic multi-channel communication ecosystem across field-facing platforms, GTM All Hands meetings, internal portals, and real-time channels
  • Serve as the air traffic controller for sales communications by consolidating updates into a prioritized calendar and collaborating with Product, Marketing, and Engineering SMEs to deliver sales-ready messaging
  • Expand change management frameworks and establish KPIs to support large-scale GTM initiatives, measure communication effectiveness, and maintain continuous field feedback loops

  • You operate with urgency. You bring a strong bias for action, deep context, and a creative point of view to every initiative without waiting for direction.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You serve as a trusted strategic partner to C-suite executives, providing candid counsel and distilling cross-functional insights from Product, Marketing, and Engineering into unified messaging.
  • You thrive in ambiguity. You navigate fast-paced environments with ease, ruthlessly prioritizing long-term strategic goals alongside urgent, high-pressure communication needs.
  • You connect vision to execution. You possess an event visionary mindset with a proven track record of orchestrating mainstage executive experiences and driving engagement across global audiences.

  • 6+ years of experience in internal and executive communications within a fast-paced cybersecurity or high-growth SaaS environment
  • Proven track record of managing mainstage content and live executive performance for large-scale events with 1,000+ attendees
  • Proven ability advising C-suite executives and driving communications strategy for global sales organizations
  • Experience expanding change management frameworks to support large-scale GTM initiatives, sales methodologies, or organizational shifts

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Demonstrate a proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency.

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、Majorチームのリージョナルディレクター直属（製造業を中心とする従業員40000名以上のお客様担当チーム）となります。

また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

In this role, you will identify where reps and sales leaders need real-time signals, and work with engineering to build and prioritize the roadmap for how AI-generated signals power seller decisions across the direct sales motion.

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead business process analysis and discovery sessions with Account Executives & Sales Management to understand the current state, then articulate the future state and where AI should help.
  • Turn ideas into actionable, AI-powered insights and recommendations by identifying where sellers and sales leadership lack clarity, context, or preparation, and map the current seller process to pinpoint where AI should help.

  • Write, test, and refine prompts and output formats for AI-generated content such as meeting briefs and deal summaries, and evaluate every output by whether it helps a seller or manager decide faster or better, retiring or reworking what doesn’t improve outcomes such as win rate, forecast accuracy, or rep productivity.
  • Monitor AI solution performance and adoption, gather seller feedback, continuously optimize output quality, reliability, and business impact, and report results to leadership to guide prioritization and investment.

title: Product Marketing Manager - AI Protect
descriptionHtml:

We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager – AI Protect to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in San Jose, reporting to the VP, Product Marketing – AI Security in the Marketing department. Enterprise security teams are navigating a two-front AI challenge: employees are adopting AI tools faster than security teams can track, creating data exposure risks and shadow AI sprawl — while adversaries are weaponizing AI to launch faster, harder-to-detect attacks. AI Protect is Zscaler's answer to both. As the Sr. PMM for AI Protect, you will own the go-to-market strategy, positioning, and field enablement for one of Zscaler's most strategically important and competitively active product lines — taking a sharp, differentiated story to market and equipping the global sales organization to win.

This role is for someone who combines competitive sharpness with genuine customer obsession — someone who understands how security teams think, what keeps them up at night, and how to build the tools that give sellers an unfair advantage.

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Own Marketing Strategy and Execution: Drive positioning, messaging, and cross-functional launch execution for AI Protect; partner closely with Product Management to translate roadmap investments into compelling market narratives
  • Develop Impactful Messaging: Create highly differentiated messaging across AI Protect’s core pillars: securing employee AI adoption (shadow AI, AI DLP, GenAI visibility) and defending against AI-powered threats (adversarial AI, AI-driven attacks)
  • Build Deep Persona Understanding: Establish a profound grasp of the multi-persona buying center—including Data Security owners, SecOps teams, Risk/Compliance officers, and CISOs—and develop tailored content for each
  • Lead Competitive Intelligence: Monitor the competitive landscape, synthesize actionable insights, and actively enable the field to confidently differentiate Zscaler's offerings and win deals
  • Drive Sales Enablement Programs: Build robust field tools—including battlecards, objection handlers, and targeted sales plays—that equip account teams to navigate complex buying cycles and accelerate revenue

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You are relentlessly curious. The AI threat landscape moves faster than any analyst report. New attack techniques, new tools, new buyer anxieties — you stay ahead of all of it, form your own point of view, and bring that perspective to everything you build.
  • You have the courage to be bold. You write competitive content with conviction. You take positions others hedge around and make sharp, arguable claims — then back them up — because that's what earns the attention of buyers who've heard every security vendor's story before.
  • You care deeply. Whether it's a battlecard or a keynote narrative, you hold yourself to a standard of excellence. You believe precision builds trust — with buyers, sellers, and your team — and that sloppy work is the fastest way to lose credibility in a competitive market.
  • You thrive in ambiguity and act like an owner — moving between strategy and execution with urgency and integrity, and holding yourself accountable to outcomes, not just outputs.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. Ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You build trust through candor, clarity, and a genuine commitment to shared outcomes.

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

title: Principal Product Marketing Manager, Zero Trust for Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Marketing Manager – Zero Trust for Agentic AI to join our team. This is as remote-eligible role for candidates located in the Pacific time zone, reporting to the VP, Product Marketing – AI Security in the Marketing department. AI agents are no longer a concept — they are in production today, acting autonomously, accessing sensitive systems, and making decisions on behalf of the organizations that built them. The security industry has barely begun to catch up. As the Principal PMM for Zero Trust for Agentic AI, you will help define how enterprises think about this problem — and why Zscaler is uniquely positioned to solve it. You will build the vocabulary, the narratives, and the go-to-market foundation for one of the most consequential emerging security challenges of our time.

This role is for someone energized by ambiguity, obsessed with getting ahead of the curve, and bold enough to take a position before the market has made up its mind.

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Own positioning, messaging, and end-to-end marketing strategy for Zero Trust for Agentic AI—articulating how Zero Trust principles apply to autonomous non-human identities, while driving core deliverables like solution briefs, pitch decks, web messaging, and sales enablement tools.
  • Build the market education foundation, developing the content and frameworks necessary to help buyers understand agentic AI risk before they can fully articulate it themselves, establishing Zscaler as the authoritative voice in this emerging category.
  • Define buyer personas across a cross-functional buying center, mapping the specific needs and motivations of Security Architects, Identity/IAM teams, Cloud Security, DevSecOps, AppSec practitioners, and CISOs navigating AI governance mandates.
  • Partner with Product Management to translate early-stage technical capabilities into compelling market narratives and help shape product evolution based on customer insights and market intelligence.
  • Engage continuously with customers, analysts, and the security research community to sharpen your point of view and ensure Zscaler stays ahead of the evolving agentic AI threat landscape.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You are relentlessly curious. Agentic AI security is being written in real time — no established playbook, no mature analyst category. You thrive in that environment. You read the research, talk to customers, and form your own point of view, because your curiosity is what makes you credible and keeps Zscaler ahead.
  • You have the courage to be bold. Category creation requires conviction. You're willing to name a problem before the market has named it and build a narrative that challenges how buyers currently think. Safe, hedged messaging doesn't create categories — bold, clear points of view do.
  • You care deeply. You hold your work to an uncompromising standard — the word choice, the argument structure, the clarity of a slide. You obsess over getting it right because you believe that quality of work is a form of respect for your audience, and that caring about the craft is what separates good from great.
  • You thrive in ambiguity and act like an owner — navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution, with integrity and a bias for action.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. Ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You give and receive candid feedback knowing it's the fastest way to earn trust and do great work together.

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • 10+ years of experience in product marketing, technical marketing, or solutions engineering for enterprise security, cloud, or SaaS—paired with a BS/MS in a STEM field, Marketing, or a related discipline
  • Proven track record in B2B positioning and messaging for complex products, with a demonstrated ability to translate technical differentiators into compelling narratives that resonate with both technical and executive buyers
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, bringing a distinct mix of precision on the page and confidence on the stage
  • High technical agility, featuring the ability to pick up new technical domains quickly and operate comfortably in early-stage product environments where market definitions and buyer vocabularies are still forming

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Deep domain expertise spanning identity security, Zero Trust access, or cloud security GTM, paired with a strong familiarity with emerging agentic AI concepts, AI governance, and the security implications of LLM-based autonomous agents.
  • Proven track record in category creation, with experience successfully launching products in nascent, unformed markets and defining security challenges before buyers fully understand them.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates intellectual courage, featuring bold positioning, original frameworks, and compelling narratives that challenge conventional thinking and help buyers see problems in a new light.

descriptionHtml:

We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Principal AI Security Specialist

About the Role

Zscaler is seeking an experienced AI Security Specialist to help customers securely adopt and operationalize AI across the enterprise. This role is designed for a customer-facing technical expert who combines the consultative strengths of a Solutions Engineer / Solutions Consultant with deep expertise in AI, GenAI architectures, and AI security.

The AI Security Specialist will partner closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, and customers to configure, demonstrate, and position Zscaler’s AI security solutions. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor on secure AI adoption, helping customers understand how to protect data, enforce policy, reduce risk, and enable safe use of AI technologies across users, applications, and workflows.

This is a highly strategic, technical, and field-facing role for someone who can engage in executive conversations, lead architecture discussions, deliver compelling demos, and support technical validation for complex enterprise opportunities.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with account teams and core Solutions Engineering teams to drive the technical strategy for AI Security-related opportunities.
  • Engage customers in discovery around AI initiatives, GenAI use cases, enterprise architecture, security requirements, and adoption challenges.
  • Configure and deliver compelling demos of Zscaler’s AI security solutions, tailored to customer priorities and business outcomes.
  • Support proofs of concept, proofs of value, and technical evaluations for strategic AI-related opportunities.
  • Advise customers on how to securely enable AI usage across the enterprise, including data protection, policy enforcement, user access, governance, and risk mitigation.
  • Translate complex AI and security concepts into clear, actionable value for technical, security, and executive stakeholders.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on modern AI technologies, including large language models (LLM), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents, prompt workflows, model usage patterns, and emerging enterprise AI architectures.
  • Help customers understand the security implications of enterprise AI adoption, including sensitive data exposure, unsanctioned AI usage, governance gaps, and operational risk.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to provide field feedback, influence roadmap priorities, and improve product positioning based on customer needs.
  • Develop reusable demos, technical assets, competitive positioning, and enablement content to help scale Zscaler’s AI field motion.
  • Enable internal teams on AI trends, AI security use cases, market messaging, and customer objections.
  • Represent Zscaler in executive briefings, customer workshops, webinars, and industry events related to AI security and secure AI transformation.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Sales Engineering, Solutions Consulting, Solutions Architecture, Customer Engineering, or Technical Advisory.
  • Deep understanding of modern AI and GenAI technologies, including:
    • Large language models (LLMs)
    • Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
    • Agents, MCP and orchestration patterns
    • Prompt workflows
    • Model usage considerations, safety, and governance concepts
  • Experience configuring, demonstrating, and presenting technical solutions in complex enterprise sales cycles.
  • Strong ability to connect technical capabilities to business value, security outcomes, and customer priorities.
  • Strong presentation, demo, and communication skills, with the ability to engage architects, practitioners, security leaders, and executives.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture, cloud environments, APIs, application workflows, and integration patterns.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, with experience in one or more areas such as:
    • cloud security
    • data security
    • zero trust architecture
    • secure access
    • governance and policy controls
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving market where AI technologies, buyer expectations, and competitive positioning continue to evolve.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in AI security, secure AI adoption, model governance, or AI-related risk management.
  • Experience helping enterprises evaluate or deploy AI technologies in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience building prototypes, demo environments, or lightweight AI applications.
  • Hands on experience with deploying infrastructure in public cloud
  • Familiarity with enterprise concerns around AI usage, including data leakage, policy violations, compliance, third-party AI tools, and governance.
  • Experience supporting strategic accounts and complex technical buying cycles.
  • Background in Python, APIs, scripting, or solution prototyping.
  • Experience creating reusable field assets such as demo content, reference architectures, technical workshops, and playbooks.
  • Familiarity with security platforms, cloud-native architecture, and modern SaaS security models.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • You become a trusted advisor to customers on both AI innovation and AI risk reduction.
  • You help customers understand how Zscaler enables secure, scalable adoption of AI across the enterprise.
  • You deliver high-impact demos and technical engagements that connect Zscaler’s capabilities to real customer priorities.
  • You improve technical win rates for AI-related opportunities through strong discovery, positioning, and technical validation.
  • You help the field scale through reusable assets, crisp messaging, and practical AI security guidance.
  • You provide actionable customer insight that sharpens product strategy and go-to-market execution.

Why This Role Matters

Enterprises are rapidly adopting AI, but they are doing so in an environment filled with security, governance, and data protection concerns. Zscaler is uniquely positioned to help customers enable AI safely through zero trust principles, secure access, policy enforcement, and protection of sensitive data.

The AI Security Specialist plays a critical role in that mission by helping customers move from AI experimentation to secure, enterprise-wide adoption with confidence.

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

descriptionHtml:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role 

We are looking for a Browser Extension Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid (Bangalore) role, reporting to the Director, Threat Researcher in the Engineering department. Zero Trust Browser is our Browser Detection and Response (BDR) extension that lives inside Chrome, Firefox, and Safari to protect users where they actually work by detecting threats, enforcing enterprise policy, and analyzing content in real time without slowing anyone down.

This is not a typical frontend role; most of the work happens beneath the UI layer in code that runs on every page a user visits across browsers we do not control and websites we have never seen. The core engineering challenges center on the browser itself: how pages load, how extension contexts communicate, how to stay fast and invisible, and how to build controls that hold up against active evasion. You will join a small, senior team as a hands-on individual contributor, owning features end to end and shaping how a large, modular codebase grows.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Design and ship extension features end to end, from the detection or enforcement logic in the browser to the user-facing experience around it
  • Write code that runs on every page load for millions of users, where speed, memory, and "don't break the website" are product requirements
  • Think like an attacker about your own work, and build controls that are hard to bypass
  • Handle the differences between Chrome, Firefox, and Safari behind clean abstractions the rest of the team can rely on
  • Diagnose problems you can't reproduce locally, using telemetry and good instrumentation

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner with a passion for the mission and a strong bias for action, operating with integrity and navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who embraces a culture of candid feedback delivered with clarity and respect to build team success and mutual trust.
  • You are customer-obsessed, anchoring your decisions in solving real-world problems and championing user needs from start to finish.
  • You are driven by innovation and energized by complex technical challenges, constantly seeking better, more secure, and scalable solutions.
  • You lead with integrity by holding yourself and others to high standards of accountability and building trust through consistent, transparent action.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with deep, hands-on TypeScript or JavaScript
  • Browser-extension experience on Chrome, Firefox, or Safari: extension APIs, manifest versions, permission models, and how content scripts, background workers, and extension pages fit together
  • Strong knowledge of the web platform itself, not just a framework on top of it: how pages load and execute, the DOM and its event model, iframes and cross-origin boundaries, web workers, browser storage, and security features like CSP
  • A genuine mental model of JavaScript: async behavior, closures, modules, and a type system you use to prevent bugs rather than annotate them
  • Comfortable building UI with any reactive library (React, Vue, Svelte, or similar) based on a deep understanding of state and rendering

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Published browser extensions and third-party code executing on unowned pages (e.g., analytics agents, embedded SDKs/widgets, payment or login iframes, bookmarklets, and userscripts)
  • Proven experience architecting IPC-driven multi-process desktop applications, engineering AppSec solutions, building browser automation/anti-bot systems (Puppeteer, Playwright, CDP), or managing low-level DOM and custom build pipelines (esbuild, Rollup, Wasm)

  • Strong technical acumen with the ability to align customer business challenges to the Zscaler portfolio for desired business and security outcomes
  • Proven ability to analyze customer data to gain key insights and develop tailored adoption strategies and risk mitigation plans.
  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

Role

We are looking for a Jira Administrator to join our Engineering team on a hybrid basis in Bangalore. In this role, you will build and support the Jira Data Center platform that our engineering, IT, and business organizations run on—writing custom apps and integrations, keeping the platform healthy at scale, and helping drive our migration to Atlassian Cloud.

This position is ideal for someone early in their career who wants to own real systems: you will start with well-scoped engineering tasks and rapidly grow into designing solutions end-to-end for the teams you support.

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Develop & Maintain Core Extensions: Build, test, and maintain custom Jira Data Center apps, plugins, and scripted extensions using Java, Groovy, and the Atlassian SDK
  • Integrate Ecosystem Tools: Build and maintain seamless integrations between Jira and surrounding systems including Confluence, ServiceNow, Slack, CI/CD pipelines, and SSO using REST APIs and webhooks
  • Partner with Stakeholders: Collaborate directly with business and engineering partners to translate raw requirements into robust Jira solutions, including custom workflows, schemes, permissions, automation rules, and reporting
  • Drive Platform Migration: Contribute to our Jira Data Center to Cloud migration through app compatibility assessments, data mapping, migration tooling, dry runs, and post-migration validation
  • Maintain Platform Operations: Support ongoing operations alongside the team, including platform upgrades, patching, performance tuning, and troubleshooting production issues across our AWS infrastructure

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You Think at Scale: You connect your day-to-day work to the larger company mission and think globally. You build solutions, processes, and architectures that are not just effective today, but are built to last and support a high-growth organization
  • You are Driven by Innovation: You possess a deep curiosity for how things work and are energized by solving complex technical hurdles. You believe in the power of technology to accelerate transformation and consistently hunt for more secure, scalable methods
  • You are a Problem-Solver: You actively seek out engineering challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hardest problems delivers the biggest business and customer impact
  • You are Data-Driven: You lean on data and analytics to uncover engineering truths, measure what matters, and guide informed architectural decisions—replacing "I think" with "I know."
  • You are a Learner: You have a true growth mindset and never stop developing your technical or leadership skills. You actively seek and implement feedback to become an exceptional collaborator and teammate

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • Experience Level: 1 to 2 years of experience in Jira Administration
  • Core Technical Skills: Working proficiency in Java (or a comparable object-oriented language), solid SQL skills, and comfort with a scripting language such as Groovy, Python, or Bash
  • API & Tooling Familiarity: Experience consuming and building REST APIs, along with familiarity with Git-based version control and standard build tooling
  • Workflow Platform Exposure: Hands-on exposure to Jira, Confluence, or a comparable enterprise workflow platform as a developer, administrator, or power user
  • Ambiguity to Execution: Ability to break down ambiguous stakeholder requests into concrete engineering tasks and ask targeted questions when requirements are thin

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Hands-on experience developing Atlassian apps using the Atlassian SDK, ScriptRunner, or Forge/Connect
  • Exposure to platform migrations or major version upgrades (especially Data Center to Cloud), alongside familiarity with AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM), Infrastructure-as-Code, or CI/CD tooling
  • Practical understanding of application performance tuning, database indexing, and troubleshooting under enterprise load

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、大手顧客担当のアカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはSaaS業界における最低5年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI/ML技術に関する基礎知識、および担当する業務領域において成果を最適化するために、AI主導型ソリューションを活用・保護・展開した経験

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

  • Experience debugging multithreaded C++: races, deadlocks, iterator invalidation, use-after-free

  • Diagnose and fix complex production issues such as service crashes, race conditions, lifetime bugs, and cross-process synchronization problems
  • Improve reliability of long-running Windows service code including cleanup/shutdown paths and inter-process communication
  • Work on VDI-specific flows including ZCC VDI SMB tunnel traffic accounting and session lifecycle management
  • Review peers' code, raise the quality bar, and mentor other engineers on Windows systems programming

  • 8+ years of production software engineering experience with strong C++ (C++14/17) expertise
  • Solid grasp of Windows internals including services, user sessions, security tokens, IPC, and process/thread lifetime
  • Experience debugging multithreaded C++ including races, deadlocks, iterator invalidation, and use-after-free
  • Proficiency with diagnostic tools like WinDbg, ETW, Process Monitor, and crash dump analysis

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における5年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

We are looking for a Sales Engineer to join our LATAM team. This is a remote role, reporting to the Manager of Sales Engineering. What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or Network Systems integrator
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent working experience

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Industry standard certifications such as CISSP, CCNA, Network+, CCNP, CCIE, or Security+

title: Account Executive, Majors (製造業)
descriptionHtml:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、製造業等のお客様を担当するMajorチーム（従業員40000名以上のお客様担当）のリージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはSaaS業界における10年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI/ML技術に関する基礎知識、および担当する業務領域において成果を最適化するために、AI主導型ソリューションを活用・保護・展開した経験

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

The Senior Staff Software Engineer (C / Networking / Dataplane) will design and implement high-performance data path features for load balancing and L7 protocols, directly enhancing the scalability and security of global networking infrastructure. By leveraging deep C programming expertise and autonomous ownership, they will drive complex architectural projects from initial concept to large-scale deployment.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Design and implement Datapath features related to Load Balancer, Firewall rules and L7 Protocol implementations
  • Apply deep knowledge of C programming, data structures, and algorithms to build high-performance systems

  • You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.
  • You think at scale. You connect your day-to-day work to the larger company mission and think globally. You build solutions, processes, and teams that are not just effective today but are built to last and support a high-growth, global organization.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • 8+ years of experience building large-scale commercial networking and security applications with proficiency in programming languages C or C++
  • Strong foundational knowledge in data structures and algorithms
  • Working experience in Linux, Unix, or similar operating systems
  • BS or MS degree in CS/CE or equivalent experience

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Exposure to AI-assisted software development tools and workflows, with the ability to apply them to improve engineering productivity and delivery quality

descriptionHtml:
