Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role Overview

Are you ready to dismantle traditional, administrative HR and build the future of talent management?

We are seeking a visionary Head of Talent Agility to join our People & Culture team. Traditional job architecture and legacy talent designations and processes are too structured and plodding for the age of AI. At Zscaler, we are building an AI-Native P&C organization, and we need a disruptive leader to architect the talent operating system that brings our enterprise talent strategy to life.  

In this role, you will architect a dynamic "talent operating system" focused on AI-powered inferred skills, self-directed career pathing, robust talent intelligence, and vibrant job marketplaces. You will champion a talent philosophy that is agile, technology-driven, and centered on uncovering emergent skillsets, and aspirations to enable seamless employee mobility, workforce agility, and next-generation succession planning.

Business Outcomes You Are Responsible For

  • Enterprise Talent Intelligence: Establish an actionable, dynamic view of enterprise talent and capabilities to identify and close critical skill gaps before they impact business velocity.
  • Talent Fluidity & Deployment: Create the intelligence and mechanisms that enable leaders and HRBPs to identify and deploy talent against the highest-priority business and capability needs.
  • Accelerated Internal Mobility: Significantly increase the percentage of roles filled internally by seamlessly matching employee skills and aspirations to open opportunities via the talent marketplace in partnership with Talent Acquisition and HRBPs.
  • Enhanced Retention & Engagement: Increase career growth and internal opportunity for high-performing and critical talent, contributing to stronger retention and engagement.
  • Robust Succession Readiness: Build a demonstrable, data-backed succession system for leadership and critical-role pipeline integrating performance, potential, skills and readiness to ensure business continuity and organizational agility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build the Talent Architecture & Intelligence Engine: Design and launch a comprehensive, modern talent architecture, intelligence and mechanisms purpose-built for an AI-native, hyper-growth enterprise, rather than constrained by traditional talent management practices, including our talent philosophy, operating principles, performance indicators, processes, and tools across talent intelligence, career architecture, mobility, talent reviews and succession integrated with Zscaler’s performance and development ecosystem.
  • AI-Powered Talent Profiling: Partner with People Strategy & Operations/People Science to translate workforce data into actionable talent intelligence to build dynamic profiles based on inferred, self-declared, and peer/manager-declared skills, moving beyond static job descriptions to map true organizational capability. Uncover emergent skillsets both internally and externally to proactively design development plans to meet future talent needs.
  • Self-Directed Career Pathing & Mobility:  In partnership with TA, HRBPs and People Technology, conceptualize and deploy an internal talent marketplace that dynamically matches employees' self-declared career interests and evolving skills with Zscaler's business needs and strategic initiatives.
  • Strategic and Proactive Talent & Succession Intelligence: Provide talent and capability intelligence that informs enterprise and functional workforce planning, succession and development strategies.
  • Translate Talent Intelligence into Action: Partner across People Success to translate talent insights into leadership, learning, performance, career and team interventions that build priority capabilities and strengthen the talent pipeline.

The skills you bring

  • 10+ years of high-impact experience in Talent Strategy, or Organizational Development, with at least 5 years in a leadership capacity (Director level or equivalent).
  • Proven track record of disruption: Demonstrated experience reimagining legacy talent practices and replacing them with simpler, agile, technology-enabled approaches centered on skills and mobility.
  • Expertise in Talent Tech & AI: Deep understanding of internal talent marketplaces, skills-ontology platforms, and talent intelligence tools. A strong appetite for utilizing AI to infer skills and drive workforce planning.
  • Strategic execution: Ability to operate with the strategic foresight of an executive advisor while remaining deeply involved in the daily craft of program building (a true player-coach).
  • Agility & Ownership: An "impact over activity" mindset, coupled with high diplomatic acumen and the ability to thrive in a matrixed, hyper-growth environment.
  • Respect the Past to Innovate the Future: Innovate by learning from the past, not being limited by it. Embrace curiosity, balance new ideas with practical application, and have the courage to challenge old ways to find simpler, more effective solutions. True innovation demands a curious mind that questions everything and applies a simplified, practical lens to discover what is essential.

In this technical, customer-facing role, you will collaborate with Sales, Product, and Engineering to lead product walkthroughs, technical workshops, proof-of-value engagements, deployments, and live troubleshooting. You will translate browser security capabilities into clear business outcomes for CISOs, security leaders, and architects.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Serve as Zscaler’s Browser Security technical specialist, leading customer discovery, demos, solution deep dives, and architecture discussions
  • Own or support POCs / POVs, including success criteria definition, test planning, execution support, and outcome validation
  • Help customers design and validate browser-layer security controls and use cases, including threat prevention, protection against browser-delivered attacks, in-browser data protection, secure workflows, and policy-based browser controls
  • Work directly with security architects, SOC teams, endpoint teams, application security teams, and CISO-level stakeholders
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success) to provide deployment guidance, policy recommendations, and troubleshooting during customer evaluations, supporting US East timezone calls as needed

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner, driven by a passion for the mission and a strong bias for action. You navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution while taking full responsibility for outcomes.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who thrives in a team-first environment. You foster open dialogue by giving and receiving constructive feedback with clarity, respect, and candor to build lasting trust.
  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for internal and external stakeholders to solve their real-world security challenges. You champion user needs from discovery to resolution, measuring success by customer impact.
  • You are driven by innovation and energized by solving complex technical challenges. You bring curiosity to understanding browser security architecture and continuously seek scalable, secure solutions.
  • You lead with integrity and high accountability, consistently aligning your actions with your commitments to foster transparency and trust across cross-functional teams.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 7–12 years of cybersecurity experience (web security, pentesting, or product specialization) within a security vendor, VAR, systems integrator, or enterprise security team
  • Hands-on experience with browser security controls and a strong understanding of web threat prevention, client-side attack surfaces, browser exploitation, phishing defense, in-browser data protection, and secure enterprise browsing, along with browser-related endpoint and network controls
  • Proven experience driving enterprise engagements (POCs, POVs, deployments) and delivering technical workshops and walkthroughs to both executive and practitioner audiences
  • Strong understanding of web and security fundamentals, including HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, DNS, browser architecture, web threats, enterprise access controls, and data protection
  • Cross-functional collaborator comfortable with direct customer interaction, live troubleshooting, hands-on technical problem solving, and supporting US East timezone meetings as needed

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Software engineering or product development experience with browser controls, web inspection, threat detection, telemetry, policy enforcement engines, and endpoint agents or extensions
  • Prior experience in applied security roles, including security research, red teaming, penetration testing, threat/malware analysis, or application security engineering

  • Architect reusable platform foundations—including networking, security, authentication, and monitoring—to standardize and secure enterprise AI/ML services
  • Define and implement system observability, evaluation, and reliability frameworks to ensure optimal performance and stability of AI systems in production
  • Drive cross-functional architectural initiatives in collaboration with product, security, and operations teams to deliver production-grade AI solutions aligned with business goals
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship on distributed systems design while translating complex architectures to non-technical stakeholders to foster alignment across the organization

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • Proven experience designing and operating large-scale, low-latency distributed systems, with deep expertise in availability, fault tolerance, consistency, and cloud-native microservices (AWS preferrable, GCP, or Azure)
  • Expertise in LLMs and production AI/ML infrastructure, including orchestration frameworks, inference systems, and full-lifecycle pipeline operations
  • Demonstrated track record of cross-organizational technical leadership, driving architectural decisions, mentoring teams, and shipping production-grade services
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, backed by a solid foundation in core computer science principles

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Demonstrate a proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Proven track record with LLM observability, explainability, and evaluation frameworks in production environments, complemented by serverless architectures for data-intensive workloads
  • Deep foundation in core systems, networking, and security architecture for distributed systems, including identity, encryption, access control, VPC, and network security

title: Account Executive, Enterprise
descriptionHtml:

Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における8年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

Role

We are looking for a Security-Compliance Program Manager to join our team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Director, Global Security-Compliance Practice in the Global Security Compliance department. Compliance helps Zscaler win. When a Zscaler team member, a customer, or a partner hits a compliance requirement, our practice is who they call trust to answer. You'll be one of the people behind building trust: part advisor, part translator, part teacher. You'll help customers navigate compliance frameworks like Zero Trust, GDPR, NIST, PCI, and HIPAA, and you'll help our field teams turn compliance requirements into relevant, relevant, and winning conversations. In every room you walk into, you'll live at the intersection of security, data protection, and compliance, making the case for how Zscaler protects customers and their data in a compliant way. This is not a back-office audit job. You'll be in front of customers, in deals, and on stage.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Represent the practice directly with customers through calls, webinars, and conferences, while clearly communicating how compliance helps accelerate deals instead of slowing them down
  • Map compliance frameworks to Zscaler capabilities control by control, using published methodology and clear labels for what we meet, partially meet, support, or leave to the customer
  • Build reusable playbooks and assets from deal-based learnings so the broader field can respond faster and more consistently next time
  • Educate SEs and AEs to handle routine compliance conversations themselves, while keeping data security at the center of every discussion so requirements stay tied to protecting customer data
  • Act as a security-compliance first responder, completing vendor security questionnaires and customer assessments accurately, quickly, and without overclaiming, while assembling the evidence and documentation needed to support responses

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You operate with a strong sense of ownership and a passion for the mission, seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution to deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • You are a high-trust partner who thrives on collaborative feedback, matching ambition for the team with direct, respectful communication to build trust.
  • You are a pragmatic builder who enjoys rolling up your sleeves to create and iterate, balancing technical execution with the rapid delivery of value.
  • You bring clarity to complex situations, outstandingly distilling technical and compliance concepts into simple, actionable plans and communication.
  • You maintain composure in fast-paced environments, viewing setbacks as opportunities and guiding team members through complexity with adaptability and resilience.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • Zscaler product understanding or the ability to build it fast, enabling you to know what the platform actually does before saying what it satisfies
  • Global compliance fluency, including working knowledge of major frameworks (such as NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, ISO 27001, DORA, GDPR, or regional equivalents) and the ability to pick up new ones quickly

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 12+ years of experience conducting security research with actionable outcomes
  • Extensive security expertise in at least one operating system alongside experience working with commercial Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) platforms
  • Security experience in at least one cloud service provider (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), Cloud architectures, and Cloud-based detection platforms
  • Software development experience in at least one scripting language (e.g., PowerShell, Python) and one compiled/assembled language (e.g., C, C++, Rust, Go)
  • Experience managing code with version control systems like git/GitHub

We’re looking for a Staff Engineer to join our Zscaler Client Connector team. You will be working on the Client Connector, which protects corporate devices by securely and privately sending traffic from those devices to Zscaler’s global network, which can apply advanced web filtering and advanced Zero Trust policies. In your role, you will predominantly be using Rust along with platform-native languages & APIs to implement high-performance networking code that runs on multiple desktop platforms. You’ll be expected to improve the code quality and to build solid, testable, and well-documented foundations. You will be most successful in this role if you have a good understanding of System Programming (virtual memory, multi-threading, process lifecycle, kernel programming, system APIs, etc.) and networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, QUIC, H/3, proxying, etc.). You will also have to interact with other languages, such as Swift, C++, and Python. As a Staff Engineer, you will be expected to make significant contributions to the design and implementation of major development projects, working closely with our product managers and other teams to implement customer-impacting features. You will work on stimulating problems born out of the scale of our deployment, and the stringent quality, performance, and security requirements of our product.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Design and implement high-performance, low-complexity networking code for the Zscaler Client Connector predominantly using Rust
  • Build solid, easily-testable, and well-documented foundations to improve code quality across multiple desktop platforms
  • Debug complex network-related problems and implement solutions using systems programming and security protocols
  • Contribute significantly to the design of major development projects and collaborate closely with product managers and cross-functional teams
  • Communicate proactively and constructively to solve stimulating scale, quality, performance, and security problems

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • Thrive in ambiguity by comfortably building paths forward in a dynamic environment, viewing uncertainty as an opportunity to create meaningful impact.
  • Act like an owner with a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution to deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • Foster high-trust collaboration, welcoming candor, respect, and constructive feedback to drive collective success for the entire team.
  • Bring a positive force to the team, approaching complex challenges with constructive energy and a contagious 'can-do' spirit.
  • Build pragmatically by balancing a drive for technical excellence with a passion for iteratively creating, testing, and shipping high-value solutions.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience with hands-on software development, in languages like C++ 
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience coding with Rust, particularly in systems programming and async frameworks like Tokio and Reqwest
  • Deep experience with networking, particularly tunneling applications and IPv4/IPv6 transport mechanisms

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Experience using AI coding tools throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC)
  • Cross-platform development experience across multiple client operating systems, including macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android
  • Experience with software development in Swift and Objective-C

We are seeking a hands-on, self-starting Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) with deep networking expertise to drive technical enablement, customer validation, and field readiness for our next-generation Zero Trust Branch solutions. In this high-impact role, you will architect and maintain complex lab environments, lead hands-on Proof of Value (PoV) customer engagements, and provide technical troubleshooting to resolve escalations. As the bridge between engineering and field teams, you will author comprehensive deployment guides, technical collateral, and test plans while delivering interactive training to systems engineers and partners. This is an ideal position for a practitioner who thrives on solving real-world enterprise networking challenges and accelerating customer adoption across distributed edge environments.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead Customer Proof of Value (PoV) Engagements & Field Validations by directly owning and executing hands-on technical PoVs, architectural demonstrations, and pilot evaluations with enterprise prospects and customers to validate technical capabilities, eliminate sales friction, and accelerate enterprise deal closure

  • Architect, Build, and Maintain Advanced Lab Topologies by designing, deploying, and maintaining resilient physical and virtual networking lab environments simulating complex enterprise branch, edge, retail network topologies to rigorously test product behavior, interoperability, and real-world scale

  • Drive Complex Technical Troubleshooting & Escalation Resolution by serving as the direct technical escalation bridge between field teams and core engineering to diagnose, reproduce, and resolve critical L2/L3 networking escalations, network segmentation challenges, and packet-level anomalies during active customer pilots

  • Author Technical Documentation, Deployment Guides, and Reference Architectures by developing production-ready technical collateral, including step-by-step deployment runbooks, reference architectures, white papers, competitive test plans, and solution briefs to standardize best practices and accelerate post-sales time-to-value

  • Deliver Field Readiness & Enablement Training by creating and conducting high-impact technical training programs, interactive workshops, and technical webinars for Systems Engineers (SEs), professional services, and channel partner architects to scale deployment self-sufficiency across distributed enterprise environments

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • Operate with a strong ownership mindset, combining a passion for the mission with high integrity and the ability to navigate seamlessly between strategic planning and hands-on execution.

  • Maintain a customer-obsessed approach, building deep empathy for internal and external stakeholders to solve real-world problems and champion their success.

  • Move with a strong sense of urgency, focusing on execution and delivering high-impact, high-quality results rapidly in a growth-oriented environment.

  • Drive innovation through deep curiosity, enjoying complex technical challenges and leveraging technology to build secure, scalable solutions.

  • Lead with integrity and accountability, consistently aligning actions with words to build trust across teams.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in technical marketing, solutions architecture, or advanced systems engineering with deep subject matter expertise in enterprise routing, switching, TCP/IP, L2/L3 network segmentation, and tunneling protocols (WireGuard, IPsec, VxLAN)

  • Proven track record of leading and winning hands-on customer Proof of Value (PoV) pilots and executive architectural evaluations within complex enterprise and distributed edge networking environments

  • Hands-on proficiency in building and maintaining multi-vendor physical and virtual network lab topologies using bare-metal appliances, hypervisors (ESXi, KVM), and network emulation platforms (EVE-NG, GNS3)

  • Advanced packet analysis and troubleshooting expertise using Wireshark, tcpdump, and traffic generation tools to diagnose real-time routing anomalies, latency/jitter, MTU issues, and NAT/firewall traversal

  • Demonstrated track record of authoring production-grade technical collateral (deployment runbooks, reference architectures, white papers) and delivering technical enablement sessions to sales engineering, professional services, and partner teams

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

  • Practical experience with Python, Bash scripting, or infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs) to automate lab deployment, test execution, and repetitive networking workflows

  • Working knowledge of public cloud networking architectures (AWS VPCs/Transit Gateways, Azure Virtual WAN, GCP Cloud Routers) or container networking environments (Docker, Kubernetes) connecting distributed branch edges to cloud workloads

  • Recognized networking or security certifications (e.g., CCIE/CCNP Enterprise or Security, JNCIP, PCNSE) or direct architectural experience with retail, kiosk, IoT/OT, or cellular WAN/5G failover deployments

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における8年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

  • Deep technical expertise in network security and protocols including proxies, firewalls, TLS, PKI, and HTTP/S

Role

We are looking for a Senior Professional Services Consultant to join our Professional Services team. This is a Hybrid, Mohali role , reporting to the Manager, Professional Services. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical authority for our enterprise customers — architecting, deploying, and optimizing solutions across the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform. As organizations navigate AI-accelerated threats, cloud-first transformation, and increasingly complex hybrid environments, you will be the expert who turns that complexity into clarity. You bring deep technical depth, a strategic consulting mindset, and the ability to engage equally well with hands-on engineering teams and senior business stakeholders — delivering outcomes that are secure, scalable, and built to last.Work Shift: 5:00 PM – 2:00 AM IST (aligned with US/American enterprise customers)

What you’ll do (Role Expectations) 

  • Own the full technical engagement lifecycle for enterprise customers — from discovery and solution design through deployment, adoption, and continuous optimization
  • Architect and integrate ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, and the broader Zero Trust Exchange across complex, multi-cloud and hybrid enterprise environments including AI-driven workload scenarios
  • Lead Zero Trust maturity assessments, technical discovery workshops, and migration planning sessions with customer and partner stakeholders at all levels
  • Guide customers on securing modern identity frameworks, SaaS ecosystems, and AI-powered workflows — translating evolving threat landscapes into actionable, platform-led security outcomes
  • Partner with sales, channel partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact consultancy and deployment services that accelerate customer time-to-value

Who You Are (Success Profile) 

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) 

  • 8+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles — Professional Services, Security or Network Consulting, Technical Account Management, Escalation Engineering, or SOC operations
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating Zscaler solutions — ZIA, ZPA, and ZDX — across large-scale, complex enterprise environments
  • Strong command of modern identity and access frameworks — SAML, SSO/IdP integrations, MFA, conditional access, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles
  • Solid foundation across networking and security fundamentals — TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSL/TLS, PAC files, GRE/IPSec tunnels, proxies, and next-generation firewalls
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML security concepts — including shadow AI risk, data loss prevention in AI-powered environments, and securing LLM and API-driven workloads

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) 

  • Hands-on experience securing cloud-native architectures on Azure, AWS, or GCP — including AI/ML pipelines — with practical exposure to SASE, SSE, and converged security frameworks
  • Understanding of AI governance, data security posture management (DSPM), and the security implications of enterprise GenAI adoption
  • Industry certifications: ZDTA / ZDTE, CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent cloud and security credentials

Role

We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on Manager – AI & Data Platform Engineering within the Enterprise Data & AI Platform Engineering department, based on a Hybrid (3 days in office) basis in Santa Clara, CA, and reporting directly to the Senior Manager – Data Strategy, to lead the evolution of our enterprise data platform into an AI-ready data and knowledge platform. Sitting at the intersection of Data Engineering, AI Platform Engineering, Knowledge Engineering, and Generative AI, you will combine a deep foundation in modern data engineering and cloud platforms with practical experience building RAG systems, knowledge graphs, AI/LLM data pipelines, and production-grade AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning architecture, engineering execution, people leadership, and platform strategy.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead a team of data and AI engineers across the US and India, owning performance, career development and day-to-day execution across both full-time staff and contractors
  • Own the Data Platform (Snowflake, dbt, Matillion) and the in-house pipelines that build the enterprise's knowledge and AI foundations, turning structured and unstructured data into trusted, AI-ready assets such as knowledge graphs and vector stores, accountable for quality, reliability and delivery
  • Turn platform strategy and architecture direction into roadmaps, quarterly plans and delivered outcomes, partnering with architects and engineering leadership and shifting focus across data, knowledge and AI work as priorities change
  • Run the platform as a product for internal customers such as domain delivery teams, BI, context and semantic teams and AI engineering, defining service levels, onboarding paths and paved roads that make self-service and AI-native development fast and safe
  • Build agentic operations that automate the team's operational work, such as pipeline monitoring, failure triage, data quality checks and remediation, and establish a reusable framework and standards that other teams can adopt for their own operations

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You are comfortable diving deep into architectural discussions, removing roadblocks for team members, and evaluating effort estimates effectively, all while empowering your senior and principal engineers to lead system design.
  • You possess a comprehensive understanding of the complete engineering lifecycle from enterprise data ingestion and transformation to knowledge retrieval, context engineering, and production agent deployment.
  • You are equally adept at driving architectural strategy and engaging in technical implementation details, making pragmatic decisions to eliminate technical debt.
  • You are an inspiring people leader committed to hiring, mentoring, and advancing engineering team members while cultivating a culture of ownership and engineering excellence.
  • Versatile across data platforms, knowledge engineering and agentic operations, you’re equally at home in any of the three. You lead a globally distributed team with an owner’s mindset and a bias for action, and you thrive in a fast-moving AI landscape.

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Practical understanding of Generative AI architectures, particularly RAG and enterprise knowledge systems, with experience designing pipelines for structured and unstructured data
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, data platform engineering, or data architecture
  • 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams with demonstrated technical and people leadership
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Python and SQL, with a solid foundation in modern data engineering and distributed systems
  • Experience designing and operating production-grade data platforms on AWS (or another major cloud platform) using modern tools such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery, along with dbt
  • Strong grounding in data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, and observability, with a proven ability to translate ambiguous problems into scalable engineering solutions

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Production experience building RAG or GraphRAG platforms, Knowledge Graphs, and graph databases (ArangoDB, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune), vector databases, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, and re-ranking
  • Hands-on experience building infrastructure for AI agents and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex, alongside LLM evaluation, AI observability, and LLMOps
  • Deep cloud-native platform engineering expertise across Kubernetes, Terraform, and Ray/Ray Data, with a track record of building internal developer platforms and reusable data and AI platform services

  • Implement and mature observability practices, including monitoring, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, and error budgets to improve service health and operational decision-making
  • Lead high-severity incident response, strengthen response playbooks, and drive deep post-incident reviews that result in durable engineering improvements
  • Partner with Engineering and cross-functional teams to conduct operability reviews and influence architecture and service design for scale, resilience, and maintainability

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • Acts as an owner with an authentic passion for operational excellence and a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and tactical execution.

  • Champions the customer experience by anchoring engineering decisions in solving critical, real-world problems for both internal stakeholders and external users.
  • Brings deep technical curiosity and an innovative mindset to solve complex architectural challenges, continuously seeking more resilient, automated, and scalable solutions.
  • Leads with unwavering integrity and high accountability, cultivating trust across organizations through transparent communication and consistent follow-through.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 8+ years of experience managing reliability, scalability, and availability for large-scale production services
  • 4+ years of people management experience leading engineering, SRE, or Production Engineering teams
  • Strong technical background in production engineering, infrastructure, or site reliability, with proficiency in programming using Python, Go, or similar
  • Strong foundation in networking protocols, Linux systems, and distributed architecture
  • Experience leading high-stakes incident management in a 24/7 on-call environment and using structured operational practices to drive service maturity

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Experience driving reliability programs involving capacity engineering, disaster recovery, chaos engineering, and resilience testing
  • Deep technical understanding of networking protocols, global routing, traffic tunneling, DNS at scale, and proxy architectures, with demonstrated success scaling high-performing engineering teams

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We are looking for a Principal, Regional Partner Programs reporting to the Senior Director, Global Partner Programs in the Channel and Alliances organization. In this role, you will own the regional build, activation, and execution of priority partner programs and go-to-market initiatives. Working with regional leadership and global program owners, you will shape program design through regional insight, lead complex launches, and drive measurable adoption. As a senior individual contributor, you will exercise independent judgment and executive influence to drive hands-on ownership from problem definition through scale.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

  • Own Regional Program Priorities & Execution: Define and execute a regional roadmap aligned with global strategy. Partner with regional Channel and Sales leadership to prioritize target partners, sales plays, resources, and business outcomes. Exercise independent judgment to manage competing priorities and execution tradeoffs.
  • Build & Adapt Partner Programs: Turn regional growth opportunities and field needs into business cases, partner offers, and program requirements. Work with global owners to design solutions, assess partner economics and downstream impacts, and lead pilots. Secure approval for changes to global program rules.
  • Lead Launches Through Stabilization: Drive end-to-end regional delivery across commercial requirements, processes, systems, enablement, and communications. Resolve ownership gaps, validate that partners and internal teams can execute, and lead post-launch stabilization. Functional owners retain accountability for their deliverables and approvals.
  • Drive Adoption & Business Outcomes: Mobilize regional teams to achieve agreed goals for partner participation, field productivity, and business contribution. Use performance data and field feedback to diagnose barriers, influence senior leaders, and drive corrective action when programs are not delivering.
  • Improve & Scale Proven Programs: Reduce manual work and recurring exceptions, build reusable playbooks, and use regional results to influence global improvements. Work with global owners to scale successful approaches across regions. Transition established programs to named ongoing owners with clear processes, performance measures, and governance.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and never stop developing yourself, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 10+ years of experience in partner programs, partner ecosystems, channel strategy, go-to-market execution, or business transformation
  • Proven success independently leading complex partner programs from design through launch, adoption, and measurable business outcomes
  • Strong understanding of multiple partner routes to market (reseller, MSSP, GSI, cloud, etc.) including partner economics and commercial models
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, resolve cross-functional tradeoffs, and translate ambiguous requirements into executable plans

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leveraging AI-driven predictive analytics or operational tools to optimize regional partner program performance, identify high-potential GTM routes, or automate partner enablement processes
  • Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, or another complex global B2B technology environment
  • Proven track record of adapting global programs across multiple countries, leading pilots, creating repeatable playbooks, and using automation to scale successful regional approaches

Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Sr Staff Applied AI Engineer to join our team. This is an On-site in Santa Clara, California or Remote (US role) role, reporting to the Sr. Manager, Applied AI Engineering in the IT/Data Strategy department. The Sr Staff Applied AI Engineer, GTM is a senior, hands-on AI builder embedded with our go-to-market organization who turns ambiguous, high-stakes ideas into secure, production-grade solutions that move revenue outcomes. Beyond engineering, you will act as a trusted transformation advisor to GTM leaders to run discovery, shape the GTM AI strategy and roadmap, and guide Build/Partner/Buy decisions where success is measured in business terms such as pipeline generated and seller productivity. In this role, you will also improve and expand the technical implementations, standards, and engineering playbooks the rest of the Applied AI team relies on, keeping our deliverables aligned with current best practices.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Assist GTM AI strategy from discovery through delivery by embedding with GTM leaders, RevOps, and product owners to map the revenue lifecycle, set the GTM AI roadmap, and advise on feasibility, cost, risk, and Build/Partner/Buy decisions
  • Build and deploy secure, production-grade AI solutions for revenue teams, designing and shipping high-impact use cases using retrieval-augmented generation, structured-data querying, and agentic workflows
  • Run each solution like a product tied to revenue, building monitoring and evaluation frameworks, implementing security controls for customer and commercial data, and establishing ROI against GTM KPIs
  • Drive adoption and change across the field by partnering with Sales Enablement, GTM Operations, and frontline managers to roll out solutions, train users, and establish tight feedback loops based on how the field actually works
  • Set the standards that multiply the team, improving and expanding reusable building blocks like retrieval pipelines, reference architectures, GTM data connectors, and engineering playbooks while mentoring other engineers

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path as you walk it and seeing dynamic environments as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner, operating with high integrity and a strong bias for action while navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embracing ongoing candor, feedback, and mutual respect as the fastest ways to earn trust.
  • You are driven by innovation, bringing a deep curiosity for solving complex technical challenges and a desire to build secure, scalable, and transformative systems.
  • You are a pragmatic builder obsessed with creating, iterating, and shipping value to users quickly without sacrificing technical excellence.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years working directly on AI and/or ML projects
  • Direct experience driving both AI strategy and execution for GTM functions (Sales, Marketing, Partner Enablement), including shipping solutions used by customer-facing teams with measurable impact on GTM metrics, and fluency in the revenue lifecycle
  • Hands-on experience across most of the components that make up modern AI solutions, including retrieval methods, reusable skill development, agentic orchestration, connecting to tools and data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent-to-agent (A2A) frameworks
  • A track record of working directly with GTM leaders on ambiguous problems, running discovery, converting unclear expectations into a concrete plan, and communicating trade-offs, risk, and architecture to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience securing AI systems and the data they access, including least-privilege access and defending against risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, and unsafe or non-compliant outputs
  • Strong engineering skills with experience deploying and running AI at scale, proficiency in Python, comfort integrating across GTM systems of record, and experience releasing and monitoring AI systems on a major cloud platform

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • GTM experience at a B2B enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity company with complex, multi-motion sales, with a prior role in RevOps, Sales Engineering, or GTM Strategy being a strong plus
  • Direct experience with graph-based knowledge systems and long-term agent memory, including account and relationship graphs, GraphRAG, or persistent context across an account’s history
  • Experience building automated evaluation frameworks, such as LLM-as-judge or regression testing for AI quality, ideally paired with A/B or holdout experiments that measure business lift in the field

We are looking for a Staff Technical Enablement Consultant to join our team. This is a Hybrid role in Bangalore, reporting to the Manager, CS Enablement in the CS Enablement department. The Staff Technical Enablement Consultant serves as the technical bridge between product architecture, instructional design, and field readiness, partnering deeply across Professional Services, Technical Success Managers, and Customer Support. This position accelerates time-to-autonomy by reproducing real customer architectures and edge-case issues in lab environments, converting that specialized work into scalable enablement assets and targeted technical coaching.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Triage and prioritize enablement requests from cross-functional teams, translating field pain points and feature releases into a deliverable enablement backlog with clear learning outcomes

  • Build and maintain high-fidelity lab sandbox topologies to replicate complex customer deployments and edge-case issues, troubleshooting hands-on with SMEs to validate root causes and workarounds

  • Create and maintain canonical enablement assets, including self-paced student guides, topology diagrams, verification rubrics, scenario drills, and troubleshooting runbooks, to increase field autonomy at scale

  • Produce authoritative, structured technical source collateral for AI-assisted content generation and perform strict quality assurance to ensure technical accuracy and prevent content drift

  • Deliver targeted, high-impact enablement interventions such as topic bootcamps, weekly office hours, and ad-hoc architecture whiteboard deep dives focused on complex topics and new releases

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing a dynamic environment as the raw material to build something meaningful.

  • You are a dedicated problem-solver who seeks out challenges and is energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hardest problems delivers the biggest impact.

  • You are a continuous learner with a true growth mindset who actively seeks feedback to develop yourself into a better partner and a stronger teammate.

  • You are a pragmatic builder obsessed with creating, iterating, and shipping, willing to roll up your sleeves to balance technical excellence with rapid value delivery.

  • You champion simplicity and are highly skilled at distilling complex problems, user needs, and technical concepts into clear, actionable plans and precise communication.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

  • 5+ years of experience in system/network engineering, cloud architecture, or technical operations with hands-on experience replicating complex topologies in virtual sandbox/lab environments

  • Experience designing and authoring technical enablement assets (labs, student guides, verification rubrics, troubleshooting runbooks/decision trees) that are clear, testable, and scalable

  • Strong foundation in enterprise networking/security concepts and the ability to whiteboard and explain end-to-end flows (e.g., packet flow, policy processing order, hybrid connectivity, IdP/SCIM concepts)

  • Demonstrated cross-functional partnering skills (PS, TSMs, Support, Enablement/LXD, Lab Infra/DevOps) and ability to intake/prioritize requests based on impact and urgency

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills across modalities (written self-paced content + live clinics/office hours), with a bias toward improving field autonomy

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience building/operating lab infrastructure and automation (e.g., environment provisioning, tenant resets, repeatable lab reliability) in partnership with Lab Infra/DevOps

  • Experience with AI-assisted curriculum workflows (creating “AI-ready” canonical source content, validating AI-generated learning modules, governance to prevent drift/hallucinations)

  • Track record of keeping enablement content current in fast-release SaaS environments (e.g., bi-weekly/monthly releases), and/or relevant industry certifications/upskilling momentum

You will serve as the global process owner for the Accounts Receivable, Credit, and Collections lifecycle—from executable customer order through billing and invoicing impacts, receivables integrity, cash application, credit, collections, disputes, credits and rebills, write-offs, and cash realization.
This is a strategic process leadership role, not a transactional billing, AR, or collections role. You will be accountable for the global AR, Credit & Collections process architecture, control framework, KPI model, transformation agenda, India OTC COE outcomes, and end-to-end operational performance. You will ensure Zscaler operates with one integrated AR, Credit & Collections process, one KPI architecture, one transformation roadmap, and one accountable global leader across the customer-facing cash chain.

What You’ll Do — Role Expectations
  • Serve as the global process owner for the end-to-end AR, Credit & Collections chain, including billing impacts, AR management, cash application, credit risk evaluation, collections strategy and execution, disputes, credits/rebills, write-offs, and cash realization.
  • Own the global AR, Credit & Collections process architecture, controls, data requirements, KPI framework, and performance outcomes across receivables integrity, DSO, AR aging, cash application automation, collections effectiveness, disputes, and bad debt.
  • Provide global leadership to the India OTC COE in partnership with the Director, Order Management & Billing and Director, AR, Credit & Collections, including delegated authority, KPIs, escalation thresholds, and outcome ownership.
  • Partner cross-functionally (Sales Operations, Deal Desk, Legal, Provisioning, Product, Pricing, Technical Revenue, Revenue Accounting, Treasury, Controllership, Business Transformation, IT) to improve upstream order quality and contract terms, preventing downstream AR, credit, and collections issues.
  • Lead the AR, Credit & Collections transformation agenda, including automation and analytics across billing exceptions, credits/rebills, cash application, collections prioritization, dispute routing, exception queues, and human-touch reduction.
Who You Are — Success Profile
  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for internal and external customers and recognizing that strong AR, credit, and collections practices support long-term relationships and sustainable growth.
  • You act like an owner, operating with integrity, a bias for action, and the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution in AR, Credit & Collections.
  • You are a problem-solver who seeks out complex AR, credit, and collections challenges, using data, judgment, and cross-functional collaboration to design durable solutions.
  • You operate with urgency, driving high-impact results quickly across AR health, DSO, cash flow, and dispute resolution in a high-growth environment.
  • You think at scale, building global processes, teams, and solutions that are effective today and built to support a high-growth, multi-region technology business.
What We’re Looking For — Minimum Qualifications
  • AI Fluency: Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance workflows and augment problem-solving in AR, credit, and collections.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in accounts receivable, credit, collections, order-to-cash, revenue operations, finance operations, controllership, finance transformation, or a related field.
  • Experience leading large-scale global AR, Credit & Collections or OTC operations in a public company or high-growth enterprise environment.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end AR, credit, and collections processes, including billing and invoicing, AR management, cash application, credit policies, collections strategies, disputes, credits/rebills, write-offs, and cash realization.
  • Demonstrated ability to own process architecture, controls, KPIs, transformation roadmap, global operating performance, cross-functional governance, and distributed COE operating models.
What Will Make You Stand Out — Preferred Qualifications
  • Applied AI & Automation experience using generative AI, LLMs, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics to optimize credit scoring, AR portfolio management, collections workflows, exception handling, and dispute routing.
  • Experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud, software, technology, subscription, usage-based, or consumption-based business models and their AR, credit, and collections nuances.
  • Experience with CPQ, CLM, ERP, billing platforms, cash application tools, collections platforms, workflow tools, and finance transformation programs.
  • Public company experience with SOX controls and audit-ready operational processes for AR, credit approvals, collections activities, write-offs, and disputes.
  • Demonstrated success improving billing accuracy and receivables quality, reducing credits/rebills and dispute aging, improving DSO, reducing bad debt/write-offs, increasing cash application automation, and reducing human touches per transaction.

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における10年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI/ML技術に関する基礎知識、および担当する業務領域において成果を最適化するために、AI主導型ソリューションを活用・保護・展開した経験

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・具体的なAI関連スキルの保有、または実務での活用経験

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

We are looking for an Principal Software Development Engineer (Layer 7 Security & Proxy) to join our team. This architect role is essential to provide technical leadership for the ZIA proxy architecture, with a strong focus on advanced Layer 7 protocols and SSL inspection.   • Establish reference architectures and design patterns for ZIA components and integrations
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural governance across virtual and product teams

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path as you walk it and viewing dynamic environments as the raw material to create something meaningful.

  • You think at scale, connecting your daily work to the larger mission to build solutions that support a high-growth, global organization.
  • You lead with integrity by holding yourself and others to high standards of accountability and building trust through consistent, transparent action.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 12 + years of experience of total experience and proven experience in designing and implementing networking security software and public clouds infrastructure
  • Deep understanding of Proxies, HTTP/2, QUIC, TCP/IP, TLS/DTLS and SSL proxies
  • Proficient in C language
  • Demonstrated success in designing, optimizing, and troubleshooting high-throughput, low-latency network security products
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or  related field

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Mastery of TCP/IP, DNS, Http(s), VPN technologies (IPSec, SSL VPN), NAT, and load balancing
  • Knowledge of BSD/Linux operating systems, virtualization technologies, and DPDK or similar kernel bypass techniques

About the Role

As the Senior Systems Engineering Director (Senior SED) for Majors, you will lead the pre-sales engineering organization across our highest-revenue majors accounts. You are a second-line leader responsible for managing first-line Systems Engineering Directors (SEDs), Principal Architects, and senior Individual Contributors.

Partnering directly with Area Vice Presidents (AVPs) of Sales, you will own technical go-to-market execution, capacity planning, and technical win rates across the region. You will move the team beyond reactive technical demonstrations and open-ended POCs into a disciplined engineering motion: validating deals against clear C-level business metrics, generating technical pipeline, and scaling practical AI workflows across the field.

Key Responsibilities

1. Regional GTM Strategy & Capacity Governance

  • Partner with Regional Sales VPs on quarterly territory reviews, account tiering, and technical coverage planning.
  • Balance and govern SE team capacity across accounts, setting clear criteria to allocate engineering resources where win probability and deal value are highest.
  • Manage second-line operational metrics: technical win rates, POV cycle times, and resource utilization across the region.

2. Proof-of-Value (POV) Governance & Deal Execution

  • Enforce clear entry and exit criteria for all customer evaluations, requiring documented executive business goals and CISO/CIO alignment before committing technical resources.
  • Hold SE Directors and Managers accountable for operational rigor: tracking 30-day technical validation milestones, maintaining shared customer war rooms, and preventing scope creep.
  • Act as executive technical sponsor on flagship deals, partnering with account teams during late-stage negotiations and high-stakes executive playbacks.

3. SE Pipeline Generation (SE PG) & Account Expansion

  • Drive a culture of technical pipeline generation, leading teams to proactively uncover new expansion opportunities through architectural reviews, zero trust maturity workshops, and executive threat briefings.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Professional Services to identify expansion paths within existing Major accounts and protect renewal health.

4. People Leadership & Workforce Development

  • Hire, develop, and retain high-performing SE Directors, SE Managers, Principal Architects, and Senior SEs.
  • Drive structured performance management, succession planning, and leadership development across your management layer.
  • Foster a high-accountability, collaborative engineering culture aligned with our core values: Communicate. Collaborate. Continuously Improve.

5. Cross-Functional Product Feedback Loop

  • Run regular field retrospectives to synthesize product gaps, competitive threats, and integration bottlenecks encountered during POVs.
  • Deliver structured, data-backed telemetry to Product Management and Engineering leadership to prioritize roadmap decisions that directly unblock revenue.

6. Field AI Tooling & Operational Modernization

  • Drive adoption of modern AI tooling across your organization—equipping SEs to use LLMs and automation for faster RFP responses, lab automation, discovery synthesis, and solution modeling.

Success Profile

  • Operational Rigor: You build systems, cadences, and standards so that technical execution is consistent across all teams rather than dependent on individual heroics.
  • Executive Presence: You speak fluently with CISOs, CIOs, and Enterprise Architects, translating technical capabilities into business risk reduction and ROI.
  • Collaborative Leadership: You forge tight partnerships with Sales, Product Engineering, Channels, and Post-Sales services to drive seamless customer lifecycle management.
  • Decisiveness: You know when to qualify out of bad deals and pull resources from stalled evaluations to protect team focus and deal velocity.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of technical pre-sales engineering experience in enterprise software, cybersecurity, cloud architecture, or networking infrastructure.
  • 5+ years in a formal leadership capacity, with demonstrated experience managing managers (second-line leadership) or leading large, distributed field engineering organizations ($100M+ ARR scope).
  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • Proven track record partnering with Senior Sales Leadership (RVPs/AVPs) on quota attainment, capacity forecasting, and complex MEDDPICC-governed sales motions.
  • Deep knowledge of Zero Trust principles, SASE/SSE architectures, cloud security, and enterprise networking.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience establishing or overhauling POV governance frameworks, reducing evaluation cycle times, and improving technical win rates.
  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs.
  • Direct experience engaging with Fortune 500 / Global 2000 C-level security and IT executives.
  • Track record of incorporating modern AI-assisted engineering tools and automation into pre-sales workflows.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent enterprise experience.
